arc.sensitivity_note: Artificial coordinate perturbations; a sensitivity check, not observed movement or a confidence interval.

mesh.inference: Conditional Gaussian Laplace approximation; hyperparameters fixed using validation, not INLA or full hyperparameter integration.

source.prior_season_feature_window: 2022-2024 regular-season-coded box scores in the supplied archive only, fixed before 2025
source.history_rule: Only completed earlier regular-season games; constant within game; frozen at regular-season end for playoffs.
source.evaluation_limit: The 2025 evaluation periods have already been examined. They are reused benchmarks, not an untouched final season.
source.expected_points_target: Observed 0/2/3 field-goal outcome mix; missed-shot attempt values are not authoritatively supplied.

selection.gp_seed_rule: Highest retained-draw count, then bulk ESS, within the same configuration; not the best-performing seed.
selection.tree_seed_rule: Equal mean of the three validation-selected seed fits.
selection.evaluation_limit: The 2025 evaluation periods have already been examined. They are reused benchmarks, not an untouched final season.
selection.compute_stage: Stopped on the user's later credit limit; evaluate completed runs only.

compute.gpu_type: H100 requested; completed results verified on NVIDIA H100 80GB. Later H200 workers were stopped before results completed.
compute.basis: Measured completed in-function GPU allocation times times the H100 rate; interrupted work, CPU/RAM/startup and credits are reported separately from this lower bound.

budget_stop.reason: User reported only USD1 of Modal credit remaining, superseding the earlier minimum-spend target. Stop all paid GPU work and finish locally.
budget_stop.billing_note: Interrupted allocations are included in Modal resource usage, not in the completed-result timer.

modal_billing.attribution: Only description wnba-atlas-data1-20261115 or source=data1/run=20261115 tags
modal_billing.basis: Modal billing report gross resource usage before credits; may include partial current-hour buckets and reporting delay. Not cash paid after credits.
